SELECT log_date AS time,
       'VCP' || right(split_part(equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) || ' · RUN → ' || current_status AS title,
       'previous_status = ' || previous_status || ', current_status = ' || current_status AS text,
       'VCP' || right(split_part(equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) AS tags
FROM public.eap_api_vcp_status_change
WHERE $__timeFilter(log_date)
  AND previous_status = 'RUN'
  AND current_status <> 'RUN'
  AND ('All' IN (${equipment_id:sqlstring}) OR equipment_id IN (${equipment_id:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY log_date DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH exits AS (
    SELECT equipment_id, log_date
    FROM public.eap_api_vcp_status_change
    WHERE $__timeFilter(log_date)
      AND previous_status = 'RUN' AND current_status <> 'RUN'
      AND ('All' IN (${equipment_id:sqlstring}) OR equipment_id IN (${equipment_id:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT a.log_date AS time,
       'VCP' || right(split_part(a.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) || ' · ' || a.error_code AS title,
       a.error_msg AS text,
       'VCP' || right(split_part(a.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) AS tags
FROM exits e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    -- the last ALARM-severity trigger in the quarter hour before the machine
    -- left RUN: at most one annotation per exit
    SELECT log_date, error_code, error_msg, equipment_id
    FROM public.eap_api_vcp_alarm
    WHERE equipment_id = e.equipment_id
      AND alarm_status = 'Triggered'
      AND error_type = 'ALARM'
      AND log_date <= e.log_date
      AND log_date >= e.log_date - interval '15 minutes'
    ORDER BY log_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
) a
ORDER BY a.log_date DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT min(log_date) AS time,
       'VCP' || right(split_part(equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) || ' · ' || jobkey AS title,
       'jobkey = ' || jobkey AS text,
       'VCP' || right(split_part(equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) AS tags
FROM public.eap_api_vcp_upp
WHERE $__timeFilter(log_date)
  AND jobkey IS NOT NULL AND jobkey <> ''
  AND ('All' IN (${equipment_id:sqlstring}) OR equipment_id IN (${equipment_id:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY 'VCP' || right(split_part(equipment_id, '-', 1), 2), jobkey
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 200;

description:
Wall display for the vertical copper plating (VCP) lines: one card per line with state, current job, bath temperatures, the 18 plating rectifiers (current and voltage of side A and side B), the 18 circulation pumps and the newest alarms. Every value is read directly from eap_api_vcp_upp, eap_api_vcp_status_change and eap_api_vcp_alarm.

**Wall display (kiosk):** open `/d/ims-vcp-realtime-wall?kiosk&_dash.hideTimePicker=true&_dash.hideVariables=true&_dash.hideLinks=true`. Kiosk mode alone keeps the filter, time and link bars (about 105 px) and pushes the bottom of the cards off a 1080-line screen; with them hidden the whole panel fits 1920 × 1080.

**Relation to the other VCP boards:** 01 is the analysis layer (trends, lots, alarm codes); 02 is the operations console with the full rectifier matrix. This board shows the same live data in a card layout for a screen on the floor. The charts (current, voltage, baths, speed, state timeline, alarm log) are on board 02; this board is the live panel alone.

**Data:** a new row lands in `eap_api_vcp_upp` about once a minute. A line with no row for more than 5 minutes before the right edge of the range is stale: its card turns grey and says how old its data is. Units the source does not give are shown without a unit.

panels.description:
**Use it when:** the lines are running and the floor needs one screen that shows every line at once.

**How to read it:**
- **Status pills** (All / RUN / IDLE / DOWN) set this board's `status_filter` and keep the time range.
- **Header strip:** lines selected, with *live* (RUN with live data) and *stale* counts; fleet total current of the lines still sending data; rectifier stations drawing current out of 54 on those same live lines (a stale board reads 0 while its cards keep their last stations); and Triggered alarm rows (ALARM + Warning) in the range.
- **One card per line:**
  - **Header:** line (hover for `equipment_id` and factory), `waveform` (*not specified* when the source leaves it empty; a DUMMY job shows its waveform text, e.g. *DC DUMMY*), latest `current_status` and the time since it changed. A stale line says *No data* and how long ago.
  - **Job strip:** `jobkey`, `line_speed` (m/min), `density` (ASD), `plating_time` (min) and width × height (mm).
  - **7 chemical process baths and 3 support baths:** the sensor reading (`preset_*`; the source swaps the two names for bath temperatures). Green is inside the alert-rule band (4 °C for the copper and rectifier baths, 10 °C for the others). Amber is outside it and adds the recipe setpoint (`actual_*`) beneath the reading. `prep` has only `actual_prep`, which holds one fixed value per line on every row, so it is the setpoint: the tile says *n/a* where the reading would be and stays neutral; a reading of 0 means no reading and is grey.
  - **18 plating rectifiers:** two rows of nine stations. Each tile gives the current of side A and side B (`actual_current_*a / *b`, A). Green is running normally, amber means a side is more than 5 A from its setpoint, and grey *OFF* means neither side draws current. The section title gives the stations active, the total amps and the mean voltage; the voltage per side is on board 02.
  - **18 circulation pumps:** green runs at its setpoint (`actual_pump` = `preset_pump`), grey is off. Amber means the reading differs from `preset_pump` and shows the reading as recorded; the source gives no unit.
  - **Latest alarms:** the four newest Triggered rows up to the right edge of the range, counting both the rows inside the range and those from the 24 hours before it that had no Reset when the range began (a standing alarm). Each shows code, message and either the Reset time and duration or *open · no Reset yet*. *Unreset* counts codes whose newest event is still Triggered. Because of the standing alarms this list can show rows while the footer counts none.
  - **Footer:** the latest state change and the Triggered rows inside the range by `error_type`; the total is ALARM plus Warning, and the header tile sums it over the lines.

**Labels:** the card uses plain names; the source columns are `jobkey` (Job), `line_speed` (Speed), `density` (Density), `plating_time`, `width × height` (Panel), the bath `preset_*` reading over the `actual_*` setpoint, and `actual_pump` against `preset_pump`. The equipment_id and factory show as a tooltip on the line name.

**Kept on board 02:** voltage per rectifier side, Cu preset current, the check-mode codes, thickness, plating area a / b, Cu thickness limits and the fleet mean density and speed. This board shows what a glance from the floor needs.

**Colour:** four colours, one meaning each. Green: normal (a rectifier side drawing current within 5 A of its setpoint, a pump at its setpoint, a bath in its band, a line in RUN). Amber: off setpoint; an amber bath shows its setpoint and an amber pump its reading, which a green one leaves out. Red: an alarm or a line down. Grey: off, idle, stale or no data. Nothing else carries a hue.

**Calculated from:** the newest `eap_api_vcp_upp` row of each line at or before the right edge of the range (either name of the line, since the machines were renamed on 2026-09-11), the latest `eap_api_vcp_status_change` row, and `eap_api_vcp_alarm` filtered by `error_type`.

targets.rawSql:
-- LOCAL: the setting ends with this query and never rides on to the next
-- query that reuses the pooled connection
SET LOCAL jit = off;
WITH latest_upp AS (
    -- one card per physical line: the newest row of either name is the line's
    -- reading. One backward probe of the log_date index per line; sorting every
    -- wide row of the history to keep one per line spilled 65 MB per worker
    SELECT u.*
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT right(split_part(sel, '-', 1), 2) AS code
          FROM unnest(ARRAY[${equipment_id:sqlstring}]) AS sel) c
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT x.*
        FROM public.eap_api_vcp_upp x
        WHERE x.log_date <= to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0)
          AND x.equipment_id LIKE '%-VCP'
          AND right(split_part(x.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) = c.code
          AND x.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
        ORDER BY x.log_date DESC, x.log_id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) u
),
latest_status AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (right(split_part(s.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2)) right(split_part(s.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) AS line, s.equipment_id, s.current_status, s.log_date as status_time
    FROM public.eap_api_vcp_status_change s
    WHERE s.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
      AND (s.equipment_id LIKE '%-VCP' AND right(split_part(s.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) IN (SELECT right(split_part(sel, '-', 1), 2) FROM unnest(ARRAY[${equipment_id:sqlstring}]) AS sel))
      AND s.log_date <= to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0)
    ORDER BY right(split_part(s.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2), s.log_date DESC, s.log_id DESC
),
active_alarms AS (
    SELECT right(split_part(a.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) AS line, COUNT(*) as alarm_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.error_type = 'ALARM') AS alarm_crit,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.error_type = 'Warning') AS alarm_warn
    FROM public.eap_api_vcp_alarm a
    WHERE $__timeFilter(a.log_date)
      AND a.alarm_status = 'Triggered' 
      AND a.error_type IN (${severity:sqlstring})
      AND a.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
      AND (a.equipment_id LIKE '%-VCP' AND right(split_part(a.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) IN (SELECT right(split_part(sel, '-', 1), 2) FROM unnest(ARRAY[${equipment_id:sqlstring}]) AS sel))
    GROUP BY 1
),
alarm_cleared AS (
    -- four newest triggers per line (standing alarms not reset before window + triggers in window)
    SELECT right(split_part(u.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) AS line, r.*
    FROM latest_upp u CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT al.equipment_id, al.log_date, al.error_code, al.error_msg, al.error_type,
               c.log_date AS reset_at,
               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.log_date - al.log_date)) AS open_s,
               row_number() OVER (ORDER BY al.log_date DESC, al.log_id DESC) AS rn
        FROM public.eap_api_vcp_alarm al
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT z.log_date FROM public.eap_api_vcp_alarm z
            WHERE z.equipment_id = al.equipment_id AND z.error_code = al.error_code
              AND z.alarm_status = 'Reset' AND z.log_date >= al.log_date AND z.log_date <= to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0)
            ORDER BY z.log_date ASC LIMIT 1
        ) c ON true
        WHERE al.equipment_id LIKE '%-VCP' AND right(split_part(al.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) = right(split_part(u.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2)
          AND al.alarm_status = 'Triggered'
          AND al.log_date <= to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0)
          -- implied by both branches below; stated so the index scan stops here
          AND al.log_date >= to_timestamp(${__from} / 1000.0) - interval '24 hours'
          AND (
              al.log_date >= to_timestamp(${__from} / 1000.0)
              OR (
                  al.log_date >= to_timestamp(${__from} / 1000.0) - interval '24 hours'
                  AND (c.log_date IS NULL OR c.log_date >= to_timestamp(${__from} / 1000.0))
              )
          )
          AND al.error_type IN (${severity:sqlstring})
        ORDER BY al.log_date DESC, al.log_id DESC
        LIMIT 4
    ) r
),
alarm_flat AS (
    SELECT line,
           MAX(to_char(log_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS')) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS at1,
           MAX(error_code) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS code1,
           MAX(error_msg) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS msg1,
           MAX(error_type) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS type1,
           MAX(CASE WHEN reset_at IS NULL THEN 'open · no Reset yet'
                    WHEN open_s < 60 THEN 'cleared ' || to_char(reset_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || floor(open_s)::int::text || ' s'
                    ELSE 'cleared ' || to_char(reset_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || ROUND((open_s/60.0)::numeric,1)::text || ' min' END) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS dur1,
           MAX(to_char(log_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS')) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) AS at2,
           MAX(error_code) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) AS code2,
           MAX(error_msg) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) AS msg2,
           MAX(error_type) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) AS type2,
           MAX(CASE WHEN reset_at IS NULL THEN 'open · no Reset yet'
                    WHEN open_s < 60 THEN 'cleared ' || to_char(reset_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || floor(open_s)::int::text || ' s'
                    ELSE 'cleared ' || to_char(reset_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || ROUND((open_s/60.0)::numeric,1)::text || ' min' END) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) AS dur2,
           MAX(to_char(log_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS')) FILTER (WHERE rn=3) AS at3,
           MAX(error_code) FILTER (WHERE rn=3) AS code3,
           MAX(error_msg) FILTER (WHERE rn=3) AS msg3,
           MAX(error_type) FILTER (WHERE rn=3) AS type3,
           MAX(CASE WHEN reset_at IS NULL THEN 'open · no Reset yet'
                    WHEN open_s < 60 THEN 'cleared ' || to_char(reset_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || floor(open_s)::int::text || ' s'
                    ELSE 'cleared ' || to_char(reset_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || ROUND((open_s/60.0)::numeric,1)::text || ' min' END) FILTER (WHERE rn=3) AS dur3,
           MAX(to_char(log_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS')) FILTER (WHERE rn=4) AS at4,
           MAX(error_code) FILTER (WHERE rn=4) AS code4,
           MAX(error_msg) FILTER (WHERE rn=4) AS msg4,
           MAX(error_type) FILTER (WHERE rn=4) AS type4,
           MAX(CASE WHEN reset_at IS NULL THEN 'open · no Reset yet'
                    WHEN open_s < 60 THEN 'cleared ' || to_char(reset_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || floor(open_s)::int::text || ' s'
                    ELSE 'cleared ' || to_char(reset_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok','HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || ROUND((open_s/60.0)::numeric,1)::text || ' min' END) FILTER (WHERE rn=4) AS dur4
    FROM alarm_cleared GROUP BY line
),
alarm_standing AS (
    SELECT line,
           count(DISTINCT error_code) FILTER (WHERE reset_at IS NULL) AS open_codes,
           count(DISTINCT error_code) FILTER (WHERE reset_at IS NULL AND error_type = 'ALARM') AS open_crit,
           count(DISTINCT error_code) FILTER (WHERE reset_at IS NULL AND error_type = 'Warning') AS open_warn,
           count(DISTINCT error_code) AS codes_seen
    FROM alarm_cleared GROUP BY line
),
alarm_top AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (line) line, error_code, error_msg, n FROM (
        SELECT right(split_part(al.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) AS line, al.error_code, al.error_msg, count(*) AS n
        FROM public.eap_api_vcp_alarm al
        WHERE $__timeFilter(al.log_date) AND al.alarm_status = 'Triggered' AND (al.equipment_id LIKE '%-VCP' AND right(split_part(al.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) IN (SELECT right(split_part(sel, '-', 1), 2) FROM unnest(ARRAY[${equipment_id:sqlstring}]) AS sel))
          AND al.error_type IN (${severity:sqlstring})
        GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) t
    ORDER BY line, n DESC, error_code
),
classified AS (
    SELECT 
        u.equipment_id AS "Machine",
        COALESCE(u.factory, '3') AS "Factory",
        'VCP Line ' || right(split_part(u.equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) AS "DisplayName",
        COALESCE(s.current_status, 'NO DATA') AS "StateLabel",
        LOWER(COALESCE(s.current_status, 'no-data')) || CASE WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - u.log_date > INTERVAL '5 minutes' THEN ' is-stale' ELSE '' END AS "StateClass",
        COALESCE(s.status_time, u.log_date) AS status_time,
        to_char(COALESCE(s.status_time, u.log_date) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'HH12:MI:SS AM') AS "LastTime",
        CASE
          WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - u.log_date > INTERVAL '5 minutes' THEN 'No data ' || CASE
              WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - u.log_date < INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - u.log_date)) / 60)::TEXT || 'm ago'
              WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - u.log_date < INTERVAL '1 day' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - u.log_date)) / 3600)::TEXT || 'h ago'
              ELSE ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - u.log_date)) / 86400)::TEXT || 'd ago' END
          WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - COALESCE(s.status_time, u.log_date) < INTERVAL '1 minute' THEN 'Just now'
          WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - COALESCE(s.status_time, u.log_date) < INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - COALESCE(s.status_time, u.log_date))) / 60)::TEXT || 'm ago'
          WHEN to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - COALESCE(s.status_time, u.log_date) < INTERVAL '1 day' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - COALESCE(s.status_time, u.log_date))) / 3600)::TEXT || 'h ago'
          ELSE ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) - COALESCE(s.status_time, u.log_date))) / 86400)::TEXT || 'd ago'
        END AS "TimeAgo",
        COALESCE(u.jobkey, 'NO ACTIVE JOB') AS "JobKey",
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(u.waveform), ''), 'not specified') AS "Waveform",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.line_speed::numeric, 2)::text, '0.00') AS "Speed",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.plating_time::numeric, 0)::text, '-') AS "PlatingTime",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.density::numeric, 2)::text, '0.00') AS "ASD",
        COALESCE(NULLIF(u.current_check, ''), '-') AS "CurrentCheck",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.thickness::numeric, 2)::text, '-') AS "Thickness",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.width::numeric, 0)::text, '-') || ' x ' || COALESCE(ROUND(u.height::numeric, 0)::text, '-') AS "Dimensions",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.plating_area_a::numeric, 2)::text, '-') AS "AreaA",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.plating_area_b::numeric, 2)::text, '-') AS "AreaB",
        
        -- 7 Chemical Tanks: Measured PV (preset_*) as Act, Recipe SP (actual_*) as Set
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.preset_clean::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "CleanAct",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.actual_clean::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "CleanSet",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.actual_prep::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "PrepAct",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.preset_copperplating1::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "Cu1Act",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.actual_copperplating1::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "Cu1Set",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.preset_copperplating2::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "Cu2Act",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.actual_copperplating2::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "Cu2Set",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.preset_ao::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "AOAct",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.actual_ao::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "AOSet",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.preset_hotwater::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "HotWaterAct",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.actual_hotwater::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "HotWaterSet",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.preset_dry::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "DryAct",
        COALESCE(ROUND(u.actual_dry::numeric, 1)::text, '-') AS "DrySet",

        -- 7-Tank Status Classes: 'st-ok' (In-spec), 'st-warn' (Out-of-spec), 'st-na' (No data/OFF)

list.name: factory
list.label: Factory
list.query: /* skip scan over idx_vcp_upp_eqp_date: one index probe per line instead of a full scan of eap_api_vcp_upp; each line has one factory, its latest row carries it */ WITH RECURSIVE e AS ((SELECT equipment_id FROM public.eap_api_vcp_upp ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT u.equipment_id FROM public.eap_api_vcp_upp u WHERE u.equipment_id > e.equipment_id ORDER BY u.equipment_id LIMIT 1) FROM e WHERE e.equipment_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT l.factory FROM e CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT factory FROM public.eap_api_vcp_upp u WHERE u.equipment_id = e.equipment_id ORDER BY u.log_date DESC LIMIT 1) l WHERE l.factory IS NOT NULL AND l.factory <> '' ORDER BY 1;
list.description: The factory column of eap_api_vcp_upp. The table currently holds a single value; the filter stays for when a second factory arrives.
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT factory FROM public.eap_api_vcp_upp WHERE log_date > now() - interval '7 days' AND factory IS NOT NULL AND factory <> '' ORDER BY 1;

list.name: equipment_id
list.label: Line
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT 'VCP' || right(split_part(equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) FROM public.eap_api_vcp_status_change WHERE equipment_id LIKE '%-VCP' ORDER BY 1;
list.description: Physical plating lines VCP01, VCP02 and VCP03. The machines were renamed on 2026-09-11 (for example `VCP002-VCP` became `VCP02-VCP`), so every panel matches rows on the last two digits of the name. Selecting one line returns the rows of both names, and no row is lost to the rename. Old links that still pass a full machine name such as `VCP002-VCP` keep working for the same reason. The single `VCP001-L` row is not counted.
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT 'VCP' || right(split_part(equipment_id, '-', 1), 2) FROM public.eap_api_vcp_status_change WHERE equipment_id LIKE '%-VCP' ORDER BY 1;

list.name: status_filter
list.label: Status
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT current_status FROM public.eap_api_vcp_status_change ORDER BY 1;
list.description: Values the current_status column actually holds over the last 180 days: RUN, DOWN, IDLE, ALARM and PM (STOP appears only in previous_status).
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT current_status FROM public.eap_api_vcp_status_change WHERE log_date > now() - interval '180 days' ORDER BY 1;

list.name: severity
list.label: Error type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT error_type FROM public.eap_api_vcp_alarm ORDER BY 1;
list.description: Values the error_type column of eap_api_vcp_alarm actually holds over the last 30 days
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT error_type FROM public.eap_api_vcp_alarm WHERE log_date > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY 1;
